purpose: One later protected descriptive verification wave on preserved historical membership; not corrected data preparation, scoring, analysis or publication.

carrier.limits: Regular CODED preserved carrier only. No NoPII clone, fresh export, raw490, administrative file or alternate dataset fallback. Hash/order identity preserves existing manual exclusions; no exclusions are rerun or changed.

source_intake.missing_column_resolution: Complement choice_filter from richer pinned extracts only when every shared recorded column agrees; absent metadata is not an empty constraint.
source_intake.scope: Static dictionary availability only; no current schema, compiled-form deployment, routing compliance or participants verified.

operations.purpose: Load the exact projected carrier once and assess unchanged membership/order, internal submission-key integrity and observable screening support.
Use actual submitted versions and item-specific routes/domains to account for six response states and literal parent/dummy consistency; no repair.
Assess preserved coded clocks, date/fecha lineage, first-arrival source limits and version-correct geography without choosing a new clock or pooling.
Aggregate applicability, valid-answer and fixed-candidate/common-input completeness; no score construction or fitted sample.

state_rules.observed_valid: Observed substantive response fits that version's domain and the accepted item-specific interpretation; exclude sentinel/N/A from scorable coverage.
state_rules.structural_skip: All required parent and own relevance conditions are known, and the item was unasked by design. A response outside route is not silently relabelled a valid skip.
state_rules.unavailable_in_version: The actual form never offered that field/option. Not a negative answer or respondent nonresponse.
state_rules.applicable_nonresponse: Known applicable and available item has a missing or blank response, after excluding recorded item-specific refusal, uncertainty, nonuse and N/A sentinel states; not a structural skip.
state_rules.substantive_NA_or_sentinel: Preserve original N/A, refusal, uncertainty and nonuse distinctions in item-specific subtypes; never apply a blanket 98/99 rule.
state_rules.unresolved: Conflicting routes, missing source context or uninterpretable response remain unresolved. Unknown state has no score and is never filled with zero.

version_reference.counts_status: Historical expectations only; no new participant tabulation. Do not reproduce small version counts in a public synopsis.

coverage_sets.rule: All three valid/applicable under accepted maps; runout has a phone route. No-phone is valid phone information, not a complete candidate.
Report raw-item availability and date-source coverage separately. Calendar-year source/bounds remain unadopted; do not certify a computable normalized candidate.
All two valid/applicable; phone transfer gate retained; confidence alone does not imply phone access.
All three valid/applicable; app installation smartphone-only. Compare IADT2/IADT3 common applicability without claiming cross-phone equivalence.
OTP familiarity and financial-app nonuse remain distinct unscored states; both phone-gated.
Address proof in process/refusal and unknown phone registration unscored; no own line is the accepted zero condition, not nonresponse.
Three activity items, not q4_16/q4_17; N/A unscored; preserve mixed 60/90-day wording and unresolved account-context conflicts.
Both registration-ease/support items valid/applicable; no activation-time component; uncertainty unscored.

model_input_coverage.labels: Potential applicable/valid input sets only. No computed outcome binary, candidate score, design-matrix encoding, automatic complete-case restriction or e(sample). Extension computability remains indeterminate without the date decision.

outputs.retention_proposal: Keep the complete restricted audit packet with research authors until an applicable institutional policy is confirmed; do not delete originals or infer a legal retention period.

count_serialization.csv_status_rule: Use an interpretive status for completed checks; use not_executed or technical_stop otherwise, with NA for uncomputed observed/discrepancy counts.

files.name: verification_readout.md
files.content: Interpret aggregate evidence as supported/unsupported/indeterminate with source/denominator limits; include every planned check and unavailable result.

files.name: execution_receipt.json
files.content: Exact approved source/projection/adapter/output hashes, owner grant, owned runtime/build/control references, actual call/load/fit/time counts and stop/cleanup disposition; no secrets or participant values.

files.name: stata_full.log
files.content: Complete restricted command/aggregate log by construction; no list/browse/tabulation displaying identifiers, participant rows, raw date/location values, free text or error-driven row dumps.

outputs.banned: KEY values, names, telephones, contact/admin/enumerator identifiers, raw multiselect strings, coordinates, individual dates, row-level flags/datasets, participant lists, scores, predictions or classes. Runtime control identity is separate restricted operational evidence, not a respondent identifier. No public result table is produced.

runtime.scope: Artificial Stage-A/B/bootstrap/deployment tests are inherited design evidence only; no current PID/build/capacity/stop/deadline proof. No actor launch or service change in this task.
requirements: Bind exact future adapter text/hash, single owned session/build and read capacity for projected fields plus explicitly planned temporary checks.
Bind independent cancellation, enforce absolute/per-selection work deadlines and cleanup allowance; late or uncertain completion quarantines the packet, not a retry.
Reserve an empty restricted destination and verify source/output noncollision before the single load.
No model fitting or fitted b/V stripes; no maxvar/runtime mutation or fallback library to rescue the wave.
Remove transient in-memory diagnostic flags and owned participant state during separately authorized cleanup; retain only permitted aggregate evidence.

scientific_holds_unchanged: Measurement suitability and final score construction
Variance/dependence, exact contrasts and nonestimable-slot treatment
LCA family/class count/identification/uncertainty and any fit manifest
D1 institutional/consent/privacy and exact joint-author/CFI publication checkpoints
completion_rule: Complete source-bound documentary preparation and audit, not passed live preflight or completed P1-P4. Unsupported/indeterminate empirical evidence would be valid later outcomes; technical/source/authority failure stops.
next_immediate_task: Owner-authorized current restricted-input resolution, missing static q3 parent-chain validation and owned empty-runtime/control preflight; no participant load/count until exact access, output, retention, budget and execution conditions are separately bound.
